# Major Office Furniture Brand Websites

Here are some well-known office furniture brands and their websites:

## Premium/Commercial Brands
- **Steelcase** – steelcase.com
- **Herman Miller** (now MillerKnoll) – hermanmiller.com / millerknoll.com
- **Knoll** – knoll.com
- **Haworth** – haworth.com
- **Humanscale** – humanscale.com
- **Teknion** – teknion.com
- **Kimball** – kimball.com
- **HON** – hon.com
- **Allsteel** – allsteel.com

## Mid-Range / Popular Brands
- **IKEA (Business)** – ikea.com
- **Autonomous** – autonomous.ai
- **Branch** – branchfurniture.com
- **Fully** – fully.com
- **FlexiSpot** – flexispot.com
- **Uplift Desk** – upliftdesk.com
- **Vari (formerly VariDesk)** – vari.com
- **Bush Business Furniture** – bushbusinessfurniture.com

## Budget-Friendly / Retail
- **Sauder** – sauder.com
- **OFM** – ofminc.com
- **Flash Furniture** – flashfurniture.com
- **Safco** – safcoproducts.com

## Ergonomic/Chair Specialists
- **Secretlab** – secretlab.co
- **Ergotron** – ergotron.com
- **X-Chair** – xchair.com
